buildCommand: curl -s https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.28.5-stable.tar.xz | tar xJ && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter/bin" && flutter pub get && flutter build web --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"
